theorem.family: monic squarefree D of degree n=2g+1 over F_q
theorem.scope: every odd prime power q and every integer g>=1
theorem.automorphism_resonance_interpretation: scaling corrections occupy degree classes 0,1 modulo d for d|q-1; translation corrections occupy multiples of p=char(F_q)
theorem.invariant_average: uniform equations equal stabilizer-weighted averaging on the declared affine quotient

proof_skeleton.scalings: after translating the fixed point, an order-d scaling fixes exactly D(S)=S^r*h(S^d), r=n mod d; squarefreeness requires r in {0,1} and h squarefree with h(0)!=0
proof_skeleton.translations: for beta!=0 in characteristic p, F_q[S]^(S->S+beta)=F_q[S^p-beta^(p-1)S]; fixed degree-n models exist iff p|n, and composition preserves squarefreeness

firewall: This counts affine presentations retaining the rational branch point at infinity, not unpointed hyperelliptic curves or the full moduli stack. It proves no Frobenius equidistribution, L-function moment, number-field transfer, RH, or GRH.
